[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Allow zero-load agents with %queue(weight=0)[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A user can author `%queue(weight=0)` or `%q(w=0)` to launch a sase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent that adds no weighted load to runner capacity. The directive [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]round-trips through every re-authoring path, the agent and its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]user-authored lineage run at weight 0 end to end, and the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]epic-launch monitor's host-set zero weight still never gives its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]successors a free ride.[/#D7D7AF]
